mapper.sql: WHERE D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN = 'N' AND E.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_JGMT_CD = 'SERVICE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SERVICE_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETE_NOCS, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT, D.DSBLTY_END_DT) END), 0) AS AVG_RECOVERY_SEC, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) END AS COMPLETE_RATE FROM dsblty_info D LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.EQPMNT_SN = D.EQPMNT_SN

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM, COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) AS TOTAL_NOCS, SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_GRD_CD = 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CRITICAL_NOCS, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT, D.DSBLTY_END_DT) END), 0) AS AVG_RECOVERY_SEC, CASE WHEN COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN D.DSBLTY_END_DT IS NOT NULL OR D.PRCS_STTS_CD = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(D.DSBLTY_NO), 1) END AS COMPLETE_RATE FROM link_sys_info L LEFT JOIN eqpmnt_info E ON E.LINK_SYS_CD = L.LINK_SYS_CD AND E.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN dsblty_info D ON D.EQPMNT_SN = E.EQPMNT_SN AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND D.DSBLTY_OCRN_DT < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND D.EXCP_APLY_YN = 'N' WHERE L.USE_YN = 'Y' AND L.LINK_SYS_CD = #{linkSysCd} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD, L.LINK_SYS_NM ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD, 'VMS','PBX','SCADA_SEC','EMS_PIDS','EMS_TX')
